decision: Do not lower the frozen 85 percent readiness floor. The zero-roll-basis index fixed contract-reset loss and produced broad mature handoff cohorts, but real elapsed-time horizons still underwarm for many post-maintenance and post-weekend opportunities. Close wall-time slow ownership. A successor may use a completed-traded-bar event clock: real weekend price gaps remain one causal shock return, roll basis remains zero, and real timestamps continue to own sessions and execution.
